14afb6278243c463dcf87b5fce8f1a889e489b22.title: FastBEVFusion: Simple Multi-Modal Fusion for 3D Object Detection at 50 FPS

method_evidence.quote_en: Based on modality-specific features, FastBEVFusion projects these features into semi-aligned modality-specific BEV spaces, without relying on a computationally intensive and potentially error-prone depth estimation.
method_evidence.interpretation_zh: 将模态特定特征投影到半对齐的模态特定BEV空间，避免显式深度估计，属于可迁移的多模态融合表征机制。

method_evidence.quote_en: Given these BEV spaces, we propose a light-weight, soft, and dynamic fusion module based on cross-attention, which adapts dynamically to the scene context and enables feature fusion across the entire BEV spaces.
method_evidence.interpretation_zh: 基于交叉注意力的轻量动态融合模块，可根据场景上下文自适应融合整个BEV空间，可迁移至多传感器特征融合。

method_evidence.quote_en: Additionally, our system shows strong robustness to calibration errors, making FastBEVFusion a powerful 3D object detection system for real-world applications.
method_evidence.interpretation_zh: 系统对标定误差鲁棒，适合真实部署场景，对多传感器融合的鲁棒性设计有参考价值。

evaluation.task_type: camera-radar 3D object detection with multimodal TPV fusion

method_evidence.quote_en: A ray-guided deformable-attention lift weights sampled image features using LiDAR-supervised camera depth probabilities and radar frustum occupancy, while radar additionally refines the depth distribution before lifting.
method_evidence.interpretation_zh: 利用雷达视锥占位与LiDAR监督深度概率对图像特征做射线引导可变形注意力提升，属于可复用的跨模态几何表征机制。

method_evidence.quote_en: Because conventional radar provides limited elevation information, LiDAR-derived class-occupancy targets supervise the side and front planes during training; the corresponding heads are removed at inference, so deployment requires only cameras and radar.
method_evidence.interpretation_zh: 训练时用LiDAR类别占用监督侧/前平面、推理时移除相关头，是训练期特权信息监督方法。

method_evidence.quote_en: For temporal aggregation, Doppler-guided temporal fusion aligns past features using a motion field anchored by measured radar radial velocity, with gating that limits warping in regions without supported motion.
method_evidence.interpretation_zh: 利用雷达径向速度锚定运动场做时序特征对齐并门控，可迁移到多传感器目标关联中的时空对齐。

transfer_path.source_quote_en: A ray-guided deformable-attention lift weights sampled image features using LiDAR-supervised camera depth probabilities and radar frustum occupancy, while radar additionally refines the depth distribution before lifting.
transfer_path.adaptation_zh: 将射线引导可变形注意力提升中的雷达视锥占位与训练期深度监督，迁移为船载相机-雷达多传感器检测中的融合输入构造：以雷达点云转换的视锥/占用作为图像特征采样权重，训练时以LiDAR或标定深度监督相机深度，推理仅保留相机与雷达；训练目标由3D框检测改为海上目标检测，结构上保留TPV平面与可变形采样。

method_evidence.quote_en: We propose a pipeline that uses a balloon burst as a single cross-modal target, which the LiDAR locates in metric coordinates, every microphone hears as a sharp onset and a camera times.

4772090254e742c3871ffa7f433bec56ac19499d.title: NSFlow: End-to-End Differentiable Neuro-Symbolic Optical Flow for Visual Odometry

method_evidence.quote_en: Our method uses a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) to extract robust feature representations, which is fed into a differentiable LK optimizer to estimate optical flow in an end-to-end trainable manner.
method_evidence.interpretation_zh: 用CNN提取特征并输入可微Lucas-Kanade优化器，端到端训练光流估计

method_evidence.quote_en: Through implicit differentiation, gradients are propagated across the iterative solver, enabling joint optimization of feature extraction and flow estimation.
method_evidence.interpretation_zh: 通过隐式微分将梯度传播穿过迭代求解器，联合优化特征提取和光流估计

transfer_path.source_quote_en: Through implicit differentiation, gradients are propagated across the iterative solver, enabling joint optimization of feature extraction and flow estimation.
transfer_path.adaptation_zh: 可将可微迭代优化器用于跨模态匹配中的关联求解：以CNN提取的船舶视觉或雷达特征作为输入，将匹配求解器设为可微的迭代关联模块（如Sinkhorn或LK式迭代），训练目标改为最小化匹配/关联损失，使特征提取与关联求解联合优化；需调整输入为多模态特征对，并替换光流几何约束为匹配相似度约束。

limitations: 摘要聚焦视觉里程计中的稀疏光流，与海事融合或船舶视觉任务无直接联系
可微优化器与跨模态匹配的迁移仅为推断，摘要未提供跨模态实验证据
论文声称的实时性和42%误差降低无法独立核实
evaluation.reason_zh: 主题为视觉里程计光流，无直接海事或跨模态匹配联系；可微迭代优化需较多适配，迁移仅属推断。
evaluation.primary_problem: 视觉里程计中经典光流对大幅运动与光照变化敏感，学习式回归方法计算重且缺乏几何一致性
evaluation.core_contribution: 提出神经符号框架，用CNN特征驱动可微LK优化器，通过隐式微分端到端联合优化特征与光流
evaluation.application_context: 视觉/视觉惯性里程计前端，嵌入式平台实时运行

4cbac4725da4a52204e3e4445f9a5333ca784ce3.title: KLTNet: Learning Sparse Feature Tracking for Robust and Accurate Monocular Visual-Inertial Odometry

evaluation.reason_zh: 面向视觉惯性里程计的稀疏特征跟踪方法，与雷达AIS关联、船舶视觉或多传感器船舶感知无直接联系；其跟踪与置信度机制虽可考虑迁移，但缺少海事匹配任务的具体适配证据。
evaluation.primary_problem: 经典 KLT 跟踪器在快速运动或低纹理场景下不稳健，影响视觉惯性里程计的状态估计精度。
evaluation.core_contribution: 提出轻量级可插拔的稀疏特征跟踪器 KLTNet，采用由粗到细、稠密到稀疏的架构，结合低分辨率稠密光流初始化和三 patch 细化，并用多视图三角化监督各向异性置信度权重。
evaluation.application_context: 视觉惯性里程计的前端特征跟踪；在 VINS-Mono 和 OpenVINS 上验证。

method_evidence.quote_en: KLTNet follows a coarse-to-fine, dense-to-sparse architecture that combines low-resolution dense optical flow for robust global motion initialization with triplet-patch refinement for accurate and temporally consistent tracking.
method_evidence.interpretation_zh: 该架构可用于跨模态匹配中的粗到细匹配策略，但原文任务是特征跟踪而非跨模态匹配。

method_evidence.quote_en: KLTNet predicts anisotropic confidence weights supervised through differentiable multi-view triangulation, which can be used as observation weights in compatible VIO estimators.
method_evidence.interpretation_zh: 可微三角化监督的置信度权重可迁移为多传感器关联中的可靠性加权，但原文未涉及跨模态关联。

limitations: 直接相关性为零，不支持通过高置信度绕过
方法面向视觉惯性里程计前端跟踪，未涉及跨模态或跨传感器关联
缺乏在海事跨模态匹配或船舶检测任务上的具体适配证据

c43b69290dbefa7150c0385becbf00e927f0978f.title: Uncertainty-DTW for Sequences and Visual Tokens

evaluation.reason_zh: 提出不确定性感知的DTW对齐框架，可处理异构噪声特征并泛化到视觉token匹配；对雷达AIS轨迹或视觉AIS跨模态关联有具体可迁移性，但摘要未涉及海事场景。
evaluation.primary_problem: 现有动态时间规整（DTW）及其可微变体依赖确定性相似度度量，对异构和噪声特征敏感，对齐结果不可靠。
evaluation.core_contribution: 提出不确定性DTW（uDTW），为每个对应关系赋予正态分布，用最大似然目标（精度加权匹配项加对数方差正则）实现结构化匹配，并将框架从时序序列推广到视觉token集合。
evaluation.application_context: 时间序列分析、人体动作识别、视觉表征学习等通用对齐任务；未涉及海事或船舶场景。

method_evidence.quote_en: Our formulation, uncertainty-DTW (uDTW), assigns each correspondence a Normal distribution and parametrizes each alignment path by a Maximum Likelihood Estimate objective consisting of (i) a precision-weighted matching term that suppresses unreliable features, and (ii) a log-variance regularization that prevents degenerate solutions.
method_evidence.interpretation_zh: 以异方差不确定性建模每个匹配点，用精度加权抑制不可靠特征，可用于雷达-AIS轨迹点或视觉-AIS特征点的跨模态关联。

method_evidence.quote_en: We further generalize this framework from temporal sequences to tokenized visual representations, enabling structured matching over sets of visual tokens.
method_evidence.interpretation_zh: 表明该方法可处理非时序的token集合匹配，支持跨模态表征对齐的迁移。

transfer_path.source_quote_en: Our formulation, uncertainty-DTW (uDTW), assigns each correspondence a Normal distribution and parametrizes each alignment path by a Maximum Likelihood Estimate objective consisting of (i) a precision-weighted matching term that suppresses unreliable features, and (ii) a log-variance regularization that prevents degenerate solutions.
transfer_path.adaptation_zh: 将雷达轨迹点与AIS轨迹点分别编码为序列/token，以uDTW的精度加权匹配项计算跨模态对应关系；训练目标改为最大化雷达-AIS匹配路径的对数似然并加入方差正则，结构上保留DTW对齐路径，但输入由单模态序列改为雷达/AIS双模态特征，并输出匹配不确定度用于后续关联门限。

limitations: 摘要未涉及海事雷达/AIS或船舶视觉数据
跨模态迁移路径为推断，需验证在异构传感器特征上的有效性
方法假设对应关系沿对齐路径结构化，可能不适用于非序列跨模态关联

evaluation.reason_zh: 将3D视觉定位重述为结构化图匹配，具备任务无关的匹配机制；可迁移至跨模态图匹配，但需较大调整，且无海事场景证据。
evaluation.primary_problem: 零样本3D视觉定位中，现有VLM方法依赖视角推理或隐式表示，组合查询下空间一致性和可解释性不足。
evaluation.core_contribution: 提出SceneGraphGrounder，将3D定位重构为在重建3D场景图上的结构化图匹配；通过视觉标记提示让VLM从2D视图推断物体间关系并提升为持久3D场景图，再构建查询图进行约束对齐。
evaluation.application_context: ScanRefer基准的零样本3D视觉定位，以及移动机器人真实环境部署；未涉及海事或船舶场景。

method_evidence.quote_en: Given a query, we construct a query graph and perform constrained alignment with the scene graph, ensuring multi-view consistency and interpretable reasoning.
method_evidence.interpretation_zh: 查询图与场景图的约束对齐可视为跨模态图匹配机制，但原任务为3D视觉定位。

method_evidence.quote_en: We propose SceneGraphGrounder, a framework that reformulates 3D grounding as structured graph matching over a reconstructed 3D scene graph.
method_evidence.interpretation_zh: 将定位转化为结构化图匹配，这一思路可迁移至雷达/AIS或视觉/AIS的图结构关联。

transfer_path.source_quote_en: Given a query, we construct a query graph and perform constrained alignment with the scene graph, ensuring multi-view consistency and interpretable reasoning.
transfer_path.adaptation_zh: 将AIS目标构建为查询图、雷达或视觉目标构建为场景图，把原文的查询图-场景图约束对齐用于跨模态目标关联；输入由3D场景图与语言查询改为AIS属性/轨迹图与雷达点迹/视觉检测图，结构需将3D空间关系编码替换为时空关系编码，训练目标改为最大化正确跨模态节点对的对齐得分。

limitations: 直接相关性低，主要面向3D视觉定位与机器人场景

缺乏跨传感器异构图的验证
